title: 2026 Prairie, the Louis Wahl house, rebuilt to its 1874 engraving
items: 2026 Prairie Avenue is no longer a placeholder draft: the Louis Wahl house now stands as the Second Empire stone-front house The Land Owner engraved in May 1874, matched against that picture from its own camera. It has a tower under a crested mansard at the north end of the front, the door at the head of its stoop under a balcony, round-headed windows throughout, and a bay and tall chimney on the south side. The plan comes from the 1911 fire-insurance map.
